design: One fixed fitted model and evaluation cohort per variant. Only calibration sample size and sampled calibration records vary.
sampling_note: Calibration samples are drawn from the same reservoir. Samples may overlap across seeds and sizes; replicates are not independent.
interpretation_limit: Exploratory dataset-specific calibration stability analysis. Balanced evaluation precision and F1 are not deployment estimates. This does not prove real-world zero-day detection.
